translations.contact.heading: Contact & location
translations.contact.lead: We’re on the Rambla, right in the centre of Alicante. Call us, write to us or, better still, come and see us.
translations.home.headline: Eat like you're at home. Gluten-free, too.
translations.home.lead: Brunch in the morning; tapas, rice dishes and burgers the rest of the day. Homemade food, just a few tables and a family welcome.
translations.home.heroPhotoAlt: Eggs Benedict with salmon and avocado, seen from above
translations.home.band: Every dish on our menu has a gluten-free option. Just ask.
translations.home.momentsHeading: From morning brunch to evening tapas
translations.home.brunchPhotoAlt: Toasts and eggs Benedict from our brunch
translations.home.brunchText: Toasts, eggs Benedict, scrambled eggs and pancakes. Or the Completo: a toast or scrambled eggs, orange juice, coffee and something sweet, for €20.
translations.home.tapasPhotoAlt: A table of tapas with squid, croquettes and patatas bravas
translations.home.tapasText: Patatas bravas, Andalusian-style squid, homemade croquettes with grandma’s secret, rice dishes and homemade beef burgers.
translations.home.alwaysGlutenFree: Our battered squid, croquettes and pancakes are gluten-free for everyone. For burgers and breakfasts we have both regular and gluten-free bread: just ask.
translations.home.crossContamination: We control cross-contamination: everything that goes into our fryer is gluten-free, and we use separate toasters for regular and gluten-free bread.
translations.home.associations: We are a member establishment of {$START_LINK}{$INTERPOLATION}{$CLOSE_LINK}, the Coeliac Association of the Valencian Community, and of {$START_LINK_1}{$INTERPOLATION_1}{$CLOSE_LINK}, a nationwide association.
translations.home.bookingHeading: We only have a few tables: best to book
translations.home.bookingText: For large groups, call us a little in advance and we’ll get everything ready.
translations.legal.heading: Legal notice
translations.legal.owner.heading: 1. Owner details
translations.legal.owner.intro: In accordance with Article 10 of Spanish Law 34/2002 on Information Society Services and Electronic Commerce (LSSI-CE), the details of the owner of this website are as follows:
translations.legal.use.heading: 2. Terms of use
translations.legal.use.text: Access to this website is free of charge and implies acceptance of this legal notice. The information published (menu, prices, opening hours) is for guidance only and may change without notice; if in doubt, please contact us directly. All prices shown include VAT. No products or services are sold or contracted through this website.
translations.legal.ip.heading: 3. Intellectual and industrial property
translations.legal.ip.body: The texts, images, logos and design of this website belong to its owner or are used with permission. Reproduction, distribution or modification without prior written consent is not permitted.
translations.legal.liability.heading: 4. Liability and links
translations.legal.liability.text: The owner is not liable for service interruptions or for damage resulting from improper use of the website. This website contains links to third-party sites, such as Google Maps, Instagram or the coeliac associations we belong to, over whose content and privacy policies we have no control. These sites receive no data about you until you click the link.
translations.legal.privacy.heading: 5. Data protection
translations.legal.privacy.body: The processing of personal data is explained in the {$START_LINK}privacy policy{$CLOSE_LINK}.
translations.legal.law.heading: 6. Governing law
translations.legal.law.body: This legal notice is governed by Spanish law. If you are a consumer, the courts of your place of residence shall have jurisdiction.
translations.legalPages.languageNote: This text is provided in several languages. In the event of any discrepancy, the Spanish version shall prevail.

translations.privacy.heading: Privacy policy
translations.privacy.controller.heading: 1. Data controller
translations.privacy.data.heading: 2. What data we process and why
translations.privacy.browsing.heading: Browsing the website
translations.privacy.browsing.body: When you visit the website, our hosting provider (Cloudflare) processes technical data about your connection, such as your IP address, date and time, the page requested and your browser type. We use this data only to serve the website and protect it against attacks and abuse.
translations.privacy.stats.body: To find out how many visits the website receives we use Cloudflare's traffic statistics, which are calculated from those same technical server logs. They do not set cookies or load any script in your browser, and they only show us aggregated data (number of visits, countries, most viewed pages) without identifying you.
translations.privacy.browsing.legalBasis: Legal basis: our legitimate interest in providing a secure website and knowing how many visits it receives (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Cloudflare keeps the technical logs for as long as necessary for the security of the service, in accordance with its {$START_LINK}privacy policy{$CLOSE_LINK}.
translations.privacy.maps.heading: Google Maps map
translations.privacy.maps.consentBody: On the home and contact pages we show our location on a Google Maps map. The map only loads if you accept the Google Maps cookies in the cookie notice or click “Show the map”. When it loads, Google receives your IP address and other technical data from your browser, and may set its own cookies. Google processes this data as an independent controller, in accordance with its {$START_LINK}privacy policy{$CLOSE_LINK}.
translations.privacy.maps.consentBasis: Legal basis: your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR and Art. 22.2 of the Spanish Law 34/2002, LSSI). If you do not give it, Google receives nothing from this website and you can use it as usual; you can also open the location directly in Google Maps. You can withdraw your consent at any time from “Cookie settings” at the bottom of every page, and delete Google’s cookies in your browser settings.
translations.privacy.bookings.heading: Bookings and contact
translations.privacy.bookings.channels: You can book or contact us by phone, WhatsApp, email or the DISH app, and send us questions by direct message on Instagram. We process the data you provide (name, phone number, email, Instagram username, date, time, number of guests and the content of your message) in order to reply and, where applicable, manage your booking.
translations.privacy.contact.legalBasis: Legal basis: handling your request or booking (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). To book a table we need at least your name and a phone number; without them we cannot handle the booking. We keep this data for as long as necessary to assist you and for no more than one year afterwards. After that period we delete it, unless the law requires us to keep it blocked for longer to deal with possible liabilities (Art. 32 of the Spanish Organic Law 3/2018, LOPDGDD).
translations.privacy.bookings.dish: If you book with DISH, DISH Digital Solutions GmbH (Germany) is the controller of its platform and informs you in its {$START_LINK}privacy policy{$CLOSE_LINK}; we are the controller of the booking data we receive. In DISH we also keep a history of your bookings, including any no-shows, to organise our tables better. Legal basis: our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR); you can object by writing to {$INTERPOLATION}.
translations.privacy.health.text: If you tell us about allergies or intolerances, this is health data. We only note it on the order when you expressly ask us to adapt your dish, with your explicit consent (Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR); we do not use it for anything else and we delete it once the service has been provided.
translations.privacy.recipients.heading: 3. Recipients
translations.privacy.recipients.body: We do not share your data with third parties unless required by law. To provide our service we rely on the following providers, who act as data processors:
translations.privacy.recipients.cloudflare: Cloudflare, Inc. (USA): website hosting, security and visitor statistics.
translations.privacy.recipients.dish: DISH Digital Solutions GmbH (Germany): booking and no-show history.
translations.privacy.recipients.messaging: For email we use Gmail, provided by Google Ireland Limited (Ireland), and for messages, WhatsApp, provided by WhatsApp Ireland Limited (Ireland), and Instagram, provided by Meta Platforms Ireland Limited (Ireland). They provide their service under their own terms and process the data in accordance with their privacy policies: {$START_LINK}Google's{$CLOSE_LINK}, {$START_LINK_1}WhatsApp's{$CLOSE_LINK} and {$START_LINK_2}Instagram's{$CLOSE_LINK}.
translations.privacy.transfers.heading: 4. International transfers
translations.privacy.transfers.withMessaging: Cloudflare may process data in the United States. These transfers are covered by the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework and, failing that, by the standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission; you can ask us for a copy by writing to {$INTERPOLATION}. Google may also process outside the EU the data in emails and, if you load the map, your browsing data, and Meta the data in WhatsApp and Instagram messages, with the safeguards described in their policies.
translations.privacy.cookies.heading: 5. Cookies
translations.privacy.cookies.banner: This website only uses third-party cookies for the Google Maps map, and only if you accept them. On your first visit we ask you with a notice in which accepting and rejecting are on the same level; you can change your decision whenever you like from “Cookie settings” at the bottom of every page. Google explains which cookies it uses on its {$START_LINK}cookies page{$CLOSE_LINK}.
translations.privacy.cookies.storage: To remember your decision we store in your browser’s local storage whether you accepted or rejected and the date, for 12 months; after that we ask you again. This is technical data, needed to respect your choice, and is exempt from consent. If Cloudflare ever needed a technical security cookie to protect the website against automated attacks, it would also be exempt (Art. 22.2 LSSI).
translations.privacy.rights.heading: 6. Your rights
translations.privacy.rights.intro: You may exercise the following rights at any time by writing to us at {$INTERPOLATION}:
translations.privacy.rights.access: Access your data and obtain a copy.
translations.privacy.rights.erasure: Request the erasure of your data.
translations.privacy.rights.portability: Request the portability of your data in a structured format.
translations.privacy.rights.withdraw: Withdraw your consent, without affecting processing carried out beforehand.
translations.privacy.rights.identity: We may ask you to prove your identity in order to handle your request.
translations.privacy.rights.complaint: If you believe we have not processed your data correctly, you can lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency ({$START_LINK}www.aepd.es{$CLOSE_LINK}).
translations.privacy.minors.heading: 7. Minors
translations.privacy.minors.body: This website is not aimed at children under 14. If you are under that age, please do not give us personal data without the consent of your parents or guardians.
translations.privacy.changes.heading: 8. Changes to this policy
translations.privacy.changes.body: We may update this policy to reflect changes to the website or to the law. The date of the last update is shown at the top of this page.
